_about: Harrow Landing's junk-and-gear shop (M3-4). The three shop weapons (one each for Red, Otis and Mox: Mox's is on sale before he joins), two vests and two charms. Earplugs and the Lucky Bolt are found or earned in town, so they are not sold here.
name: Scrap & Dent
greeting: Everything here has been hit with a hammer. Some of it twice.
